_purpose: MINT-FIDELITY READBACK — named baseline for the KNOWN-CLASS elementless-resist rows. After the gold rig mints the full mainnet spell corpus, mint_readback.mjs reads every SpellTemplate's on-chain effect rows back and scans for the legacy defect: an ALTER_RESIST (kind 11) effect minted with element=255 (spell::el_none), which mitigates zero damage (no live corpus damage source deals element=NONE). This file is the shrink-only ledger of the rows still shipping that shape.
_ratchet: SHRINK-ONLY. Per spell id: found_count > baseline_count OR a spell id absent from this ledger with any elementless-resist row = RED (a NEW regression, or the mint dropped a present element). found_count < baseline_count = PASS with a loud 'tighten me' nudge (the completion lane shrank it — update this ledger deliberately). found_count == baseline_count = PASS (known-class). transform-drift (any value/kind/turns/stat mismatch vs the authored seed) is NEVER baselined — it is always RED.
